Prompt:

You are a senior brand and web designer.
Design a modern, conversion-focused website for a company called Cerrana AI.

1. Brand & Vision

Brand name: Cerrana AI

Tagline idea: “AI that fixes your sales fundamentals, not adds more noise.”

Vision: Help small and medium businesses stop chasing shiny tools and instead build simple, reliable systems that actually generate sales. Cerrana focuses on fundamentals: a clear sales process, a well-used CRM, and practical AI that automates real work.

Core positioning:

Not just “AI for everything”

We are “AI + process + CRM” to make sales predictable

We prioritize clarity and simplicity over complexity

2. Target Audience

Small and medium business owners (service businesses, agencies, law firms, car dealers, local businesses)

Overwhelmed by tools and platforms

Want more sales, better follow-up, and less chaos in their pipeline

Mainly in the U.S. and Latin America (website in English first)

3. Main Services (Show clearly on homepage)

Create clear, visual sections for these 3 pillars:

Smart Websites & Funnels

Conversion-focused websites that act like a 24/7 sales rep

Integrated forms, booking, tracking, and lead capture

CRM Setup & Automation (on HighLevel or similar)

Pipeline design, lead stages, follow-up sequences

Automations for reminders, nurturing, and reactivation

Dashboards for owners to see what’s working

AI Voice & Chat Assistants

AI receptionists for calls and chats

Qualify leads, answer FAQs, book appointments

Integrated with the CRM so no lead is lost

Also include a small “Done-for-you packages” area with 3 tiers (Starter, Growth, Scale).

4. Visual Style & Mood

Overall mood: clean, confident, practical, slightly futuristic but not “sci-fi”

Colors: a limited palette with 1 main accent color (e.g., electric blue / teal), neutral grays, and plenty of white space.

Style keywords:

Minimal, bold headings

Clear layout

Subtle gradients and lines to suggest connectivity and systems

Use simple icons and flow diagrams (e.g., “Lead → CRM → Automations → Sales”)

Imagery:

Dashboards, pipelines, conversations, call screens

People working remotely, entrepreneurs, small business owners

Avoid generic robots; focus on human + AI working together

5. Page Structure

Design at least these pages/sections:

A. Home

Goal: Explain what Cerrana does in 5 seconds and push visitors to book a call or start a demo.

Sections:

Hero Section

Headline idea: “Stop chasing shiny tools. Build a sales system that actually works.”

Subheadline: Explain that Cerrana connects smart websites, CRM, and AI assistants into one simple setup.

Primary CTA: “Book a Strategy Call”

Secondary CTA: “See How It Works” (scrolls to process section)

The Cerrana Method (3 Pillars)

Visual layout with three columns or steps:

“Document your sales process”

“Organize everything in your CRM”

“Automate with AI where it matters”

Short description under each.

Who We Help

A section with cards for types of clients:

“Attorneys & Law Firms”

“Car Dealerships / Buy Here Pay Here”

“Agencies & Local Service Businesses”

Each card: 2–3 bullet points of typical problems and what Cerrana solves.

How It Works (Process)

4 simple steps (with icons and a visual timeline):

Discovery call & audit

Blueprint: map your sales process

Build: website + CRM + AI assistant

Launch, test, and optimize

Emphasize simplicity and clarity.

Packages / Pricing (High-level)

3 cards: Starter, Growth, Scale

Include: who it’s for, what’s included (website, CRM setup, AI assistant), and a “Book a Call” CTA on each.

Prices can be shown as “Starting at $X/month” or “Request quote”.

Testimonials / Results (even if fictional placeholders)

Example: “We stopped losing leads and finally know what’s happening in our pipeline.”

Show logos or placeholders for industries.

FAQ

Questions about:

“Do I need to understand AI?”

“What CRM do you use?”

“What if I already have a website?”

“How long does the setup take?”

Footer

Links: Services, About, Contact, Privacy

Short line about serving clients remotely in the U.S. and Latin America.

B. About

Story of Cerrana: born from frustration with overcomplicated tools

Emphasis on “We test everything on our own funnels first.”

Show values: clarity, simplicity, honest expectations, long-term partnerships.

C. Services (Detail Page)

Separate subsections for:

Smart Websites & Funnels

CRM & Automations

AI Voice & Chat Assistants

Each with:

Problem → Solution

“What you get” list

Outcomes: more booked calls, higher show-up rates, more closed deals.

D. Contact / Book a Call

Short copy: “Tell us about your business. We’ll map your sales system in 30 minutes.”

Form fields: Name, Email, Business type, Main problem, Budget range, Preferred language (English/Spanish).

Connect CTA to calendar booking (design a clear button).

6. UX & Layout Requirements

Design for both desktop and mobile; mobile must feel like an app:

Sticky bottom button: “Book a Call”

Clear CTAs repeated at strategic points

Use sections with strong headings so scanning the page is easy

Avoid long paragraphs; use bullets and short blocks of text

7. Copywriting Tone

Tone: direct, helpful, confident, slightly informal

Avoid buzzword-heavy “AI hype”

Emphasize outcomes: more revenue, better follow-up, fewer lost leads

Write all copy in clear, simple English so non-native speakers can understand.
